item.title: 2 stabbed while sleeping in home; 1 killed, another in critical condition
item.description: A man was stabbed to death and a woman was stabbed and critically injured by a suspect who allegedly attacked them while they were asleep.

item.title: Administration seeks Supreme Court approval for rapid deportations to third countries
item.description: The administration plans to ask the Supreme Court to allow continued rapid deportations of immigrants to third countries other than their own.

item.title: FDA commissioner nominee Dr. Heidi Overton attends confirmation hearing
item.description: Dr. Heidi Overton testified before a Senate committee on Thursday for her confirmation as the next FDA commissioner.

item.title: Netanyahu addresses U.N. as several leaders depart
item.description: Benjamin Netanyahu spoke on Iran and defended Israel's actions in Gaza and the West Bank amid criticism from other leaders at the U.N.
